invented.quote: Ten years on, I still haven't gotten all of it back.
invented.why: The brief gives 2016 as the year of the last limit cut, but neither the brief nor the user's additional facts state what the current year is or that ten years have passed since 2016.

invented.quote: And this cut would run three years, not one.
invented.why: The brief states that the proposed cut is recommended for three years and that bookings recovered some two years after the 2016 cut, but it does not state that the 2016 cut lasted only one year.
